This is brand new powerful medicine.
How quickly does it start to act?

Excellent, the judge will remember this anniversary!

No, we will put the powder directly on the goose.
The main thing is that other guests do not get poisoned.
Do not fear, I will do everything personally.

отойти.gloss: to step back, to move away

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'равиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to get poisoned', paired with 'отравляться'.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'рошок'). Formed with a diminutive/expressive Slavic suffix adding warmth or small scale. Common masculine noun meaning 'powder' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Нет, положим порошок прямо на гуся.
examples.trans: No, we will put the powder directly on the goose.

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'нести'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to bring (carrying)', paired with 'приносить'.
